user.title: Magic Climate
user.description: Wrap a climate entity to add UI-configured presets. The wrapped entity is fixed once the entry is created — to wrap a different one, delete this entry and add another.

abort.already_configured: This source entity is already wrapped by Magic Climate.

basic.title: Basic Options
basic.description: Choose which of Home Assistant's standard presets to expose. This entry wraps {source}; that cannot be changed here — delete the entry and add a new one to wrap a different entity.

preset_home.title: Home Preset
preset_home.description: Set the temperature band for this preset. HVAC mode and fan mode are offered as reported by the wrapped climate entity; leave either unchanged to have the preset not touch it.
